item.title: Starting with ideas
item.description: Most brands start with a logo and a price list. This one starts with ideas: essays, breakdowns of brands I admire, campaign concepts and notes on what I read.

item.title: Why an engineer cares about brand
item.description: I build apps for a living. Every app is a promise about how something will feel: fast, calm, trustworthy, fun. The brand makes that promise; the product keeps it.

item.title: Say it out loud: a campaign for SpeakUp
item.description: SpeakUp is my offline app for practising spoken English. This is a concept for how I’d launch it.
